<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  A dense grid of small tiles: an icon and a short label. Axes: columns (3, 4, 6), item (tile: icon above the
  label, chip: icon beside it), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type IconWallProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    features: Feature[];
    cols?: "3" | "4" | "6";
    item?: "tile" | "chip";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, fitCols } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    features,
    cols = "4",
    item = "tile",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
  }: IconWallProps = $props();
  const askedCols = $derived(
    ((item as string) === "chip") && ((cols as string) === "6") ? "2-6"
    : (cols as string) === "2" ? "2"
    : (cols as string) === "3" ? "2-3"
    : (cols as string) === "4" ? "2-4"
    : "3-6"
  );
  const wallCols = $derived(fitCols(askedCols, (features?.length ?? 0)));
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density}>
  <Grid cols={wallCols} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
    {#each features as f (f.id)}
      <Box
        class={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-2",
          "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border",
          (
            (item as string) === "tile" ? cn("flex-col justify-center text-center", (((density as string) === "compact") ? "p-4" : "p-6"))
            : "px-4 py-2"
          )
        )}
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={(((item as string) === "tile") ? 24 : 16)} />
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {f.title}
        </Text>
      </Box>
    {/each}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
